content:
Context: 7. Attachment for debt and maintenance

to be disbursed outside the local limits to which the Code of Civil Procedure extends, the Drawing and Disbursing Officer of the concerned Ministry/Department in India will be responsible for drawing the amounts recoverable monthly in compliance with the attachment order and remitting them to the Court concerned, unless timely intimation is received by him of the death of the Government servant or of any other event necessitating the discontinuance of such payments.
